title: Coast Guard rescues kite surfer near Barnegat Light, New Jersey
description: A 29-foot Response – Boat crew from Coast Guard Station Barnegat Light, in New Jersey, rescues a kite surfer from the water near Barnegat Light, Aug. 31, 2023. The kite surfer entered the water and needed assistance after his line became tangled with another kite surfer. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Carmen Caver)
pass_reason: calm water, mostly cabin shots, no danger on screen
